intent: Hold the small decorative icon at the start of a marker, hidden from assistive tech.
typical_uses: A glyph or a spinner that shows the kind of step a marker reports

dont_use_when.situation: A status mark that stands on its own, outside a marker row

invariants.text: MarkerIcon renders `aria-hidden="true"` on its span, so nothing inside it reaches assistive tech.
The span is a var(--icon-size-sm) square that does not shrink, and any descendant svg fills it and ignores the pointer.

a11y.by: marker.test.tsx asserts that MarkerIcon renders a span with `aria-hidden="true"`

good.title: An icon beside the text that carries the meaning

bad.title: An icon as the marker's only content
bad.why: MarkerIcon is aria-hidden, so assistive tech reads nothing for this marker; the meaning belongs in a MarkerContent beside the icon.
